name: q-basic calibrated visible constants
statement: In the 4210 branch theta_obs, alpha_EM, charge labels, masses, clocks and material labels are fixed action parameters before variation.
guard: D_X theta_obs = 0 in the calibrated branch; values are imported, not predicted.

name: EM alpha residual silence
statement: With lambda_A and g_J fixed before variation, b_alpha = D_X ln(g_J^2/lambda_A) = 0 branchwise.
guard: Does not determine the numerical alpha_EM value.

name: charge-current normalization silence
statement: If J_Q is defined by variation of the same visible matter action and charges are fixed representation/calibration labels, no source-only C_JQ slot exists.
guard: If a source-current multiplier enters before variation, it is a real residual.

name: readout/variation commutator silence
statement: A pure postprocessing readout R_post:Sol(S_vis)->Obs cannot alter the Hilbert/Noether source or regenerate a Hodge/alpha coefficient.
guard: Fails for effective actions, source-worldtube projectors, or readout maps with coefficient codomain.

name: C_Hodge_readout branch silence
statement: If spectroscopy/clock/readout is absent from S_parent and S_eff before variation, C_Hodge_readout=0 in the standard branch.
guard: Loops/EFT/readout feedback must be bounded if introduced.

name: deformation branch no-cancellation law
statement: Any pre-variation EM scale/current/readout deformation is retained as abs(C_JQ)+abs(b_alpha)+abs(dlnlambda)+abs(C_Hodge_readout)+abs(b_marker)+abs(w_EM)+abs(C_XF2).
